worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.summary: Sends bending leaves one after another: each leaf re-reads the aim at the moment it leaves, locks the first legal visible enemy along that line and curves after it, or flies straight if none is found. Already-launched leaves never re-acquire; hold the skill key to keep changing the line and spread the leaves across targets.
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.use.0: Spread the sequential leaves across moving enemies
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.use.1: Bite the first enemy exposed along your aim
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.use.2: Press on piece by piece during an open sustained window
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.descriptio: Up to %2$s leaves per round at about %1$s damage each; defence, type matchup and crit are settled on the hit.
Each leaf turns up to %1$s degrees per tick at %2$s blocks/tick; on launch it locks a legal visible enemy within %3$s blocks along the aim.
Each leaf has a %1$s block collision radius.
Consecutive leaves are %1$s apart; a round lasts longer with more leaves.

Leaves leave one after another, each re-reading the aim at its own moment: a locked leaf curves after that enemy, an unlocked one flies straight along the aim, and one striking a block shatters at the impact. Launched leaves never re-acquire; releasing the skill key stops the leaves not yet sent.
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s then costs %4$s PP, recover %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.growth.0: At level %1$s: leaf power %2$s and %3$s leaves.
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.growth.1: At level %1$s: leaf power %2$s and turn %3$s degrees/tick.
worldcombat.skill.magicalleaf.preference: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of scattering. Larger values open from further.
On: a moving enemy is preferred, because the leaves bend across its path; off: order it like a plain ranged attack.
